review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. All 13 sampled targets and all 11 Lean statements recomputed from the defining integrals in independent pure-Python quadrature (Legendre, Carlson with complex arguments including x = 0 and near the cut, Jacobi functions by inversion, pendulum against RK4, cubic integrals, real periods, AGM series). 36 source locators read at the text: DLMF 19.2, 19.4-19.8, 19.12, 19.16, 19.25, 19.26, 19.30, 22.4, 22.5, 22.8, 22.19; Salamin Theorem 1b p. 567; Carlson 1995 sec. 2 (8)-(11); Cremona sec. 3.7. 456 backticked identifiers resolved at the pins, 34 declarations opened and compared. Elaboration: 11 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe fails on all 11; signatures compared. depcheck 0 problems; automatic checks all passed; nothing changed outside the folder; description read against the head. Remaining: five small corrections (quadratic bound useless for k' <= 1/9 in the route of 2.1; Hartogs wording in 3.1; DLMF 19.16.3 and 19.2.19-20 locators; Milestone 5.2 pointer; Cremona cited for K forms in two docstrings) and two format notes. Not verifiable: Carlson 1977 Ch. 9, Byrd-Friedman 236.00/239.00, the Zulip permission.
